description: Lightning displayed at the entrance of Taif's Heart Mall in central Taif (Wikipedia survivor list, unidentified). thunder-and-lightnings.co.uk records a Lightning painted 1303 displayed at Taif since at least Feb 2009 and tentatively identifies it as 53-684, but the Lightning Association records 53-684 as crashed at Dhahran in 1980, so the true identity is unknown; 1303 is the painted code only. The mall is a public building but the display sits in its grounds.
